Commit 42e293a on wt/skeleton. Module tree + full CLI surface, green under cargo fmt / clippy --all-targets -D warnings / test (10 tests).

Spec lines satisfied:
- 'Commands (all --json; human digest second) — sessions / at / grep / explain / doctor': src/cli.rs declares all five with --repo/--since/--until/--agent/--ts/--window/--event-line and a global --json; each parses and exits 2 with 'unimplemented — flags parsed, no work done yet'. src/main.rs is the only mod declaration site; no later bead adds a mod or a subcommand.
- 'Connector trait (discover() -> Vec<SessionMeta>, read(path) -> Vec<Turn>) so a third is one file — but do not add one': src/connector/mod.rs, plus roots() for doctor and a fixed two-entry registry(). Return types are Vec not Result, which is how 'one bad line never fails a file' is enforced rather than promised.
- 'discover() -> Vec, read(path) -> Vec' / model bead fold-in: src/model.rs is real — Role, Turn, SessionMeta{path,cwd,first_ts,last_ts,turn_count,parse_failures,connector}, TimeWindow{overlaps,contains,around}, Confidence, Evidence/Signal, parse_duration (pact's spellings), parse_ts, parse_when. Module doc records why cwd is Option and why timestamps are chrono DateTime<Utc>. round_trips_through_serde_json covers every type.
- 'Scored match that always reports confidence and evidence, never a bare answer': model::Confidence + Evidence/Signal, consumed by join::Match; join::Refusal has exactly the spec's two variants with reason() returning 'no cwd match' / 'no overlap'.
- '--repo resolves to the project's encoded session directories (repo + worktrees) before any file opens': src/worktree.rs (worktrees/session_dirs/encode/for_cwd, Worktree.alive for the pruned case).
- 'sessions are append-only, so mtime prunes files outside the query window unopened': src/prune.rs partition() -> Partition{opened,skipped}, module doc states the one-sided argument.
- 'recount reads .pact/events.jsonl directly (tolerant, chain_hash ignored)': src/pact_events.rs Event/Events/read/events_path, 1-based line addressing with Events::line(n) and line_count for the out-of-range message.

Decisions the spec did not settle (reported to orchestrator): discover() takes (dirs, window) so scoping reaches the connector before it opens anything; --window is half-width either side of --ts; --since/--until accept rfc3339 or a duration-ago while --ts stays strict rfc3339; doctor takes an optional --repo defaulting to '.'; crate-level allow(dead_code) with a ponytail comment until W3 lands.

docs/format-notes.md committed as e13629b on wt/formatnotes. Full empirical scan of ~/.claude/projects on 2026-08-19: 48 project dirs, 871 JSONL files, 169,775 lines, 754.7 MB. Encoding rule derived from real cwd fields and verified on 41/48 dirs: every non-[A-Za-z0-9] char -> a single '-', case preserved; LOSSY and non-injective (/ . _ + and literal - all collapse), so --repo must encode forward and never decode. 19 line kinds tabulated with counts; assistant 85031 / user 49039 carry cwd+timestamp+role+content, the other 15 kinds never carry cwd and 12 never carry a timestamp; journal.jsonl holds only started/result and is the sole source of the 29 zero-cwd files. Pathologies: 0 bad lines, 0 truncated tails, 0 empty files, but 12 lines >=1MB and one of 16.4MB. Time: RFC3339 UTC ms, non-monotonic in 246/842 files (worst inversion 12h), mtime never precedes the last turn (0/842) so mtime pruning is sound but can overshoot by 22 days. Biggest finding, sent to orchestrator as pact-msg-87adb6361c3ba806: cwd is the process cwd, so pact-style wt/<agent> worktrees never appear in it and the spec's invoked_from->worktree->cwd join does not resolve for the fleet recount audits; the transcript-mention signal and the subagent .meta.json description must be the primary keys.

Implemented GenericJsonl in src/connector/generic_jsonl.rs (commit 1c19e18, branch wt/generic). Satisfies spec.md 'generic_jsonl: any dir of *.jsonl with {ts|timestamp, role, content|text}; documented best-effort.' Both spellings of each pair accepted (first wins unless null); RFC 3339 timestamps only, via model::parse_ts; content flattens string or array-of-{strings,{text}} with no block-type dispatch; unknown fields ignored; non-turn-shaped line increments parse_failures and is skipped ('one bad line never fails a file'); timeless/roleless lines are failures since they cannot join. roots() empty (no natural root for 'any dir'), cwd always None. Module doc says 'best-effort' and lists what it will not do. 9 tests: both spellings, precedence, block flattening, garbage line mid-file, truncated last line, empty file, timeless/roleless, missing file, roots. cargo fmt + clippy -D warnings + test all green (19 passed).

Filled in src/connector/mod.rs (commit 4924322, branch wt/connector). registry() returns the fixed pair claude_code + generic_jsonl, no plugin mechanism (spec 'Connectors (exactly two)' / 'do not add one'). candidates() walks directory entries recursively — sorted, deduplicated, opening nothing — so it finds both layouts in docs/format-notes.md §0 (238 top-level <encoded>/<uuid>.jsonl and 604 nested <uuid>/subagents/agent-<id>.jsonl); symlinked dirs are never entered so the walk cannot leave the root or loop. Trait method set and signatures untouched. Tests: registry_is_exactly_the_two, candidates_finds_both_layouts_and_nothing_else, candidates_does_not_follow_symlinked_directories_out_of_the_root. fmt/clippy -D warnings/13 tests green. Flagged to orchestrator+generic: generic_jsonl's module doc says 'does not walk subdirectories' while the shared candidates() does (a no-op over a flat dir).

Implemented src/pact_events.rs (commit 0969080): tolerant line-by-line parse of .pact/events.jsonl into Event{line,at,agent,path,invoked_from,detail}; unknown pact fields (kind, scope, ttl_secs, head, pact_version, protocol_hash, context_key) ignored via serde default; chain_hash deliberately unverified with the reason in the module doc (verifying it would make recount a second implementation of pact's integrity model — spec.md 'reads .pact/events.jsonl directly (tolerant, chain_hash ignored); the dependency is one-way'). 1-based, dense line numbering: bad lines counted in parse_failures and still consume their number so explain --event-line N (spec.md 'read event N from .pact/events.jsonl') matches sed -n Np; Events::line() out of range or unparsed is an anyhow error naming line_count, never a panic. Missing file reads as empty Events (documented); a file that exists but cannot be read is Err. Tests: this repo's own ledger (property assertions), a truncated copy of it, a synthetic junk-line fixture, and the missing-file case. fmt/clippy -D warnings/test green.

Implemented prune::partition mtime windowing in src/prune.rs (commit 4c103d7, branch wt/prune). Lower bound only: mtime < window.since proves every turn predates the window (append-only => mtime bounds the LAST turn), so the file is skipped unopened; window.until never prunes, since mtime never bounds the FIRST turn — module doc states the asymmetry explicitly and cites docs/format-notes.md §6.2 (842 files, min 0.0s, median 0.1s, zero inversions; overshoot p99 ~30h / max 22.72d from timestamp-less resume metadata, safe downward, fatal upward). No since (unbounded or upper-bounded only) => everything opened, zero stat calls. Unreadable metadata (deleted mid-scan, permission denied) => opened, not skipped: uncertainty resolves toward looking. Satisfies docs/spec.md lines 19-20 'sessions are append-only, so mtime prunes files outside the query window unopened'. Acceptance test proves unopened by opens not timing: pruned fixture is mode 000 (any File::open errors) plus a candidate that does not exist; verified by sabotage — inserting a File::open into partition fails the test. mtimes set explicitly via File::set_times. Published signatures Partition{opened,skipped} and partition(candidates,window) unchanged. fmt/clippy -D warnings/test all green (14 tests). Not merged — orchestrator lands wt/prune at the wave barrier.

src/worktree.rs implemented, commit 1c0db506 on wt/worktree. encode(): non-[A-Za-z0-9] -> one dash each, no collapsing, case preserved (format-notes.md §1.1), trailing separator stripped (§8). worktrees(): git worktree list --porcelain, main checkout first and named 'main' per invoked_from in .pact/events.jsonl; pruned worktrees reported with alive=false, never dropped. session_dirs(): encoded dirs, deduped (encoding is non-injective), opens no session file. for_cwd(): longest-prefix match so a worktree beats the repo root that is also its prefix; no heuristic for the topology-B degeneracy, it returns the repo root because that is what the cwd says. Non-git --repo returns a clean Err naming the path (deviation from the skeleton doc comment, messaged to orchestrator). Module doc carries the no-decoder prohibition. 8 tests: repo with worktrees, repo with none, pruned worktree, non-git repo, encode rule, encode lossiness, real ~/.claude/projects names (skips if absent), for_cwd prefix ambiguity. Spec lines: 'sessions under ~/.claude/projects/<encoded-path>/', '--repo resolves to the project's encoded session directories (repo + worktrees) before any file opens', 'invoked_from -> worktree path -> session cwd'.

doctor implemented in src/cmd/doctor.rs, commit de58cd1d4b0b60224e8417d49eb76379c720c8c8 on wt/cmddoctor. Reports all four things spec.md's Commands section names for 'recount doctor : connector roots, session counts, parse-failure tallies, join-readiness (events present? worktree paths alive?)': per-connector roots (verbatim, with exists), session counts and parse-failure tallies from an unbounded roots sweep (connector/mod.rs trait doc), and a repo-scoped join_readiness block with events_present (via pact_events::events_path(repo).exists(), which is the only way to tell a missing ledger from an empty one), event count, event parse failures, the full worktree list with per-checkout alive + session_dir_exists + session count, and a ready bool answering 'is a join even possible here'. Every input is a finding and every run exits 0: absorbs the W1 decision that worktree::worktrees() errs on a non-git --repo, so the Phase-3 bare-tempdir obligation ('calm degradation, never a panic') passes. --json prints the report struct, no --json prints a digest rendered from the same struct. 8 new tests (46 total green): bare tempdir, nonexistent --repo, git repo with events and no sessions, empty vs missing ledger, corrupt ledger, pruned worktree, session counting under the encoded dir, and the only ready==true shape.

resolve() implemented in src/join.rs, commit 7016abb (branch wt/join). Scores the spec's three signals (docs/spec.md L41-47 'The join (the whole point)'): topological chain invoked_from -> worktree path -> session cwd via worktree::for_cwd; time-window overlap as a hard gate (no overlap = Refusal::NoOverlap, never a low score); transcript mention of the PACT_AGENT name or bead id, matched on word boundaries. Every outcome explains itself: Match{confidence, non-empty evidence} or one of the two refusals, distinguished (no cwd match vs no overlap) with a detail naming what was examined. AMENDMENT: degeneracy is detected from the data — Topology::{ProcessPerAgent, Ambiguous, SubagentPerAgent, Unnamed}, degenerate unless exactly one surviving candidate cwd names the queried worktree. When degenerate, topology scores 0.2 (filter) instead of 0.5 (discriminator), the mention becomes decisive, and the observed regime is named in the Topology evidence string. Topology B tops out at 0.65 with a mention and 0.40 without (below CONFIDENT=0.5, so at refuses). 13 unit tests, incl. the pinned topology-B case (three sessions, identical cwd, overlapping windows, mention-only discrimination), each signal in isolation, both refusals, the pruned worktree, and an invariant test that no outcome is ever bare. cargo fmt + clippy -D warnings + 52 tests green.

claude_code connector implemented against docs/format-notes.md; commit 7a0750e on wt/claudecode. Spec lines satisfied: 'claude_code: sessions under ~/.claude/projects/<encoded-path>/*.jsonl' and 'Tolerant parsing: unknown fields ignored, truncated tails counted not fatal, one bad line never fails a file.' Both layouts (top-level + subagents/agent-<hex>.jsonl with its .meta.json sidecar), journal.jsonl refused (notes 2.4). content String|Vec<Block> incl. tool_result.content; thinking extracted in full and tagged. Skipped line kinds are not parse_failures. cwd is a set: SessionMeta.cwd = most frequent (ties by first appearance), whole set on Identity::cwds. 8MB line cap with the oversized tail drained not buffered. Spans are min/max, never first/last. Identity carries agent_id + sidecar.description for the join. worktree.rs duplicate projects_root() and its ponytail marker removed. 49 tests green (was 38): fixture tree covering both layouts, both content shapes, thinking, skipped kinds, garbage, non-object line, truncated tail, empty file, oversized line, multi-cwd; plus a real-corpus test that skips when ~/.claude/projects is absent (read 11,145 turns from 40 real files here). Corrected two observations in docs/format-notes.md in the same commit: section 2/2.3 (a system line carries a string content only 345 of 1,963 times; turn_duration and stop_hook_summary are telemetry) and section 7.4 (truncated_tail cannot be reported distinctly because SessionMeta has no such field - it is one parse failure on the last line).

Implemented recount sessions in 907e83d (branch wt/cmdsessions), plus the folded-in generic_jsonl W1 follow-up. 45 tests green (was 38), clippy -D warnings clean, fmt applied. Spec lines satisfied (docs/spec.md): - Commands: 'recount sessions --repo

[--since --until] : sessions whose cwd resolves into the repo or its worktrees, fleet-identity guesses attached.' - Commands preamble: 'all --json; human digest second'. - Refusals: '(1) --repo resolves to the project's encoded session directories (repo + worktrees) before any file opens' and '(2) sessions are append-only, so mtime prunes files outside the query window unopened' — session_dirs first, dirs that do not exist dropped, then discover -> candidates -> prune::partition. - Proof obligations: 'run every command against a repo with events but NO sessions — calm degradation, never a panic'. Empty list, exit 0, digest says so in words. House style set for the other four commands: --json emits a versioned {command, schema, ...} envelope on stdout ALONE with the human digest on stderr second; without --json the digest alone on stdout. emit() takes its sinks so the split is tested. Fleet identity is shaped as an inference: key named fleet_identity_guess, nullable agent, mandatory confidence, never-empty evidence (when the guess is empty the evidence says why). Signals: topology via worktree::for_cwd, and a literal PACT_AGENT= scan of the file bytes. Two names is no guess unless the cwd worktree breaks the tie, at lower confidence. Both signals are the ones format-notes §4.3 measured. generic_jsonl follow-up (pact-msg-42dd8b3d0a239337): (a) the 'no recursion' promise in its module doc was the wrong half — the doc now states the shared candidates() walk and why recursion is right; (b) discover() proven end to end, the path W1 could not test: three files, one nested two levels down, one pruned unopened on mtime (mode 000 so an opener could not answer), one whose mtime cannot be ruled out but whose real span can. Known ceiling, filed not hidden: recount-hwk.44 — tie_to_repo reads the single SessionMeta.cwd summary, so a session holding several cwds (format-notes §4.2, 46 of 871 files) can be counted in excluded_by_cwd rather than listed. Counted, never silent. Raised by claudecode on pact-msg-229b6cd0ee47491b, replied, ponytail comment left at the site.
